name: DeadPunk OS
description: A handmade OS-shaped index for text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and project-control tools.
identity: text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and small tools for keeping AI-assisted work operational.
github_pages_derivation: Each project GitHub Page uses the standard repository Pages URL derived from its GitHub repository URL.
readme: A small OS-shaped index for text systems, behavioral contracts, AI protocols, and project-control tools.
I built these tools to reduce drift, force useful decisions, and keep messy AI-assisted work usable.

routing.trigger: AI response misses depth or starts hallucinating
indecision keeps the work moving without deciding
idea or output looks plausible but structurally weak
Codex keeps making the same mistakes; discipline the work environment
Codex needs to slow down and clear the frame before touching the work
new ChatGPT project starts from fog
ChatGPT needs files, but your local disk is not invited

projects.title: A.D.A.M.
projects.route: AI response misses depth or starts hallucinating
projects.job: Keeps AI chats at the right depth.
projects.problem: Simple questions stay simple. Complex work does not become unclear or overloaded.

projects.title: Memory-Assisted Shaping
projects.problem: Decisions, gates, discarded paths, and source boundaries get lost before the final artifact is ready.
projects.output: Cleaner final artifacts after controlled shaping.

projects.title: PA-PVP
projects.route: indecision keeps the work moving without deciding
projects.job: Turns vague plans, artifacts, or stuck decisions into an operational next move.
projects.output: Verdict, one next action, and a continuation point.
projects.note: argues so you do not have to

projects.title: PA-PVP mini
projects.route: idea or output looks plausible but structurally weak
projects.job: Stress-tests ideas, plans, prompts, procedures, code, and AI outputs.
projects.problem: Plausible material can hide gaps, weak logic, missing constraints, and shaky fixes.

projects.title: Signal Rail
projects.job: Keeps live project material in the right place.
projects.problem: Decisions, open work, ideas, constraints, and handoff notes collapse into one messy document.
projects.output: Separated rails for state, decisions, ideas, constraints, handoff, parking, and archive.

projects.title: CSBP
projects.route: Codex keeps making the same mistakes; discipline the work environment
projects.job: Keeps reusable Codex practices explicit, reviewed, and controlled.
projects.problem: Useful guidance either stays buried in chat history or gets promoted too quickly into project rules.
projects.output: A small companion layer for practices worth reusing, but not strong enough to become project rules.
projects.note: not a rule, not a vibe

projects.title: SensecraftXStudio
projects.route: Codex needs to slow down and clear the frame before touching the work
projects.job: Keeps AI-assisted technical work grounded before the assistant acts.
projects.problem: The assistant can stay plausible after the frame has drifted.
projects.output: Visible target, context, assumptions, action boundary, and final state.

projects.title: GPT-PF / ChatGPT Project Forge
projects.route: new ChatGPT project starts from fog
projects.job: Prepares starting files for a ChatGPT Project.
projects.problem: Projects start from memory, chat momentum, or informal notes instead of explicit files.
projects.output: Scope, sources, constraints, and starting basis before the real work begins.

projects.title: Cloudflare R2 Remote MCP Worker
projects.type: Cloud file storage bridge + authenticated remote MCP
projects.route: ChatGPT needs files, but your local disk is not invited
projects.job: Gives ChatGPT-style MCP clients a controlled remote place to read and write files.
projects.problem: ChatGPT does not work like a local desktop app with direct disk access. If it needs files through MCP, the endpoint has to be reachable remotely.
projects.output: A Cloudflare Worker that connects ChatGPT to Cloudflare R2 storage through remote MCP tools, protected by GitHub OAuth.
projects.note: tiny cloud closet, because local disk access was not invited
